measurement_pipeline.physical_spacing: Original NIfTI spacing adjusted independently for x and y according to resize scale factors.
measurement_pipeline.area: binary LV cavity area in mm^2

geometry_method_selection.note: PCA showed only a small advantage. The selection applies to this predefined two-method comparison.

interpretation.geometry_component: Substantial EF disagreement remains even when ground-truth LV masks are used, showing that single-plane geometric estimation/reference differences contribute independently of segmentation.
interpretation.segmentation_component: Predicted masks introduce additional error into area, length, volume and EF measurements.
interpretation.error_additivity: Error components must not be treated as directly additive because signed errors can interact and partially cancel.
